body: This 2025 Sprinter AWD 170 Extended in our El Capitan Tier is built for travelers who want a high-end adventure van with serious comfort, entertainment, storage, and off-road capability. With an 800Ah Battle Born power system, pop top, raised dinette lounge, indoor shower with pull-out toilet, full kitchen, convection microwave, Starlink, smart TV, upgraded lighting, satin green exterior wrap, rugged suspension, recovery gear, ski storage, traction boards, and rear door storage upgrades, this build is made for long trips, remote campsites, and life on the road without giving up luxury.
